statement: The 2019 CEVVIN catalogue explicitly reports mass grubbing-up and deterioration of vineyards with autochthonous and regional cultivars in an unspecified previous period; later research independently documents old-vineyard clearing and isolated vines surviving where vineyards once stood, but does not define the book's phrase 'previous decades'.

location: Местные сорта / Почему автохтонов так мало / программы сохранения
book_quote: программ, которые отобрали бы лучший генетический материал до вырубки, не существовало
statement: CEVVIN states that special programmes had not preserved the affected vineyards and selected the best genetic material before their clearing; this is a retrospective claim about vineyards already lost, not proof that Serbia had no selection or conservation work at all, since documented clone and sanitary selection began in 2006 and later programmes are active.
category: история программ сохранения и клоновой селекции

location: Местные сорта / Почему автохтонов так мало / генетический потенциал
book_quote: «Центр за виноградарство» называет это прямо: постоянная потеря генетического потенциала страны
statement: CEVVIN's 2019 institutional catalogue says that Serbia lost significant areas of autochthonous and regional cultivars and calls this a permanent loss of its grapevine genetic potential; its current genetic-resources page likewise describes each unexamined cleared local-variety vineyard as irreplaceable.

location: Местные сорта / Почему автохтонов так мало / сохранённое наследие
book_quote: Автохтоны в Сербии сегодня — не наследство, которое берегли
statement: The absolute denial of preservation conflicts with the same institutional and research corpus: CEVVIN describes conservation, inventory, clonal selection and collection-vineyard work, while a 2024 sustainability study models 10,402 Serbian vineyards planted with local wine cultivars and distinguishes endangered from sustainable vineyards.

location: Местные сорта / Почему автохтонов так мало / случайно уцелевшие лозы
book_quote: а то, что случайно уцелело
statement: A 2024 genetic study did include isolated vines that survived clearing in meadows and forest edges, but most of its 138 sampled vines came from extant old vineyards; this supports a survivor pathway for some material, not the claim that all Serbian autochthonous cultivars now present survived only by chance.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / статус каталога
book_quote: Официальный каталог относит к автохтонным и региональным сортам целую группу
statement: The source is CEVVIN's 2019 institutional publication on autochthonous and regional grape cultivars, issued by a Republic-founded expert centre; it is authoritative sector material but not the statutory Serbian variety register, and its combined heading deliberately includes cultivars with different origin statuses.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / Tamjanika crna
book_quote: црна тамьяника прямо названа региональной и международной одновременно
statement: CEVVIN explicitly calls Tamjanika crna both a regional and an international cultivar and explains that it is included because the Negotinska Krajina variant may have somewhat different morphological and quality traits.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / Kavčina
book_quote: кавчина пришла из Центральной Европы и растёт в Австрии и Германии
statement: CEVVIN states that Kavčina, also called Žametovka, originates from Central Europe and is cultivated in Austria and Germany as well as several Serbian winegrowing areas.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / Vranac
book_quote: вранац связывают с Черногорией
statement: CEVVIN identifies Vranac as a cultivar of Montenegro that spread through Balkan winegrowing areas; the English Wikipedia cultivar article and Montenegrin clonal-selection literature independently agree on the Montenegrin origin association.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / позиция Петровича о Prokupac
book_quote: по-настоящему исконным сербским сортом он считает только прокупац
statement: In an April 2025 interview Aleksandar Petrović does first call Prokupac the only unquestionably Serbian autochthonous or original cultivar, but immediately says Začinak could be a second and Kreaca could possibly be autochthonous; a January 2026 interview strengthens Začinak to an almost certain second cultivar, so the book omits material qualifications to his position.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / позиция о Bagrina
book_quote: багрину относит к румынским
statement: The 2025 interview accurately reports Petrović's view that Bagrina is considered Romanian, but this is an attributed expert opinion rather than settled catalogue consensus: VIVC assigns Braghina Rosie to Serbia and a 2024 genetic study likewise treats it as Serbian and identifies it as a major Balkan founder.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / позиция о Kadarka
book_quote: кадарку связывает с Черногорией и Венгрией
statement: The cited April 2025 interview contains no Kadarka discussion. A later January 2026 interview quotes Petrović linking Kadarka with the name Skadarka and a Hungarian claim, but does not expressly assign it to Montenegro; the Montenegro association comes from a separate disputed Lake Skadar origin hypothesis, while VIVC assigns Kadarka Kek to Hungary and other expert catalogues describe a broader Hungarian-Balkan or possible Ottoman background.
category: точность атрибуции и спор о происхождении

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / позиция о Tamjanika
book_quote: тамьянику выводит из французских мускатов
statement: Petrović does not derive Tamjanika from French Muscats: he identifies white Tamjanika with Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains, also known as Muscat de Frontignan and Gelber Muskateller, and says its autochthonous status is uncertain because Greeks regard it as theirs and it is widely grown; VIVC assigns Muscat à Petits Grains Blancs to Greece, while CEVVIN explicitly avoids prejudging the Tamjanika group's origin.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / балканская сеть родства
book_quote: генетика показывает плотную балканскую сеть родства
statement: A 2024 peer-reviewed study of 138 vines from old Serbian vineyards found that most identified profiles formed a complex pedigree network connecting many cultivars from different Balkan countries, consistent with centuries of plant-material exchange across the region.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / пределы генетического вывода
book_quote: из которой ни длительность выращивания, ни единственный центр происхождения не выводятся
statement: The same study explicitly says its analyses were not designed to determine how long each cultivar had been grown in Serbia and that archaeological comparison would be needed; its cross-border network and exchange history also do not by themselves locate one unique geographic birthplace, although genetic data can establish identities, pedigrees and evidence consistent with long regional presence.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / значение термина местный
book_quote: «местный» здесь чаще значит «укоренившийся столетия назад», а не «выведенный тут»
statement: A 2024 Serbian sustainability paper deliberately uses 'local' as an umbrella for autochthonous, regional and old cultivars grown in Serbia for a long time, avoiding a literal origin taxonomy; this supports the book's operational distinction, but not the stronger implication that every cultivar in the group has a documented centuries-long Serbian history.

location: Местные сорта / Насколько автохтонны автохтоны / значение спора
book_quote: От исхода спора, впрочем, ничего не меняется
statement: Origin disputes need not change inclusion in a clearly declared editorial umbrella of long-grown local cultivars, but they remain material to exact autochthonous, regional and introduced classifications, source attribution and provenance claims; the statement is defensible only as a limitation of the book's chosen terminology, not as a general conclusion.

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / число сортов
book_quote: В сербских виноградниках растёт около двухсот сортов
statement: A 2024 peer-reviewed Serbian study reports 224 grapevine cultivars used in Serbia for commercial grape and wine production, so 'about two hundred' is accurate for that defined commercial scope but should not be read as a count of every accession, synonym or non-commercial vine present in the country.

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / преобладание международного сортимента
book_quote: западноевропейские в них преобладают ... статистически основа сцены другая
statement: Register-based sector sources support the broader proposition that Serbian commercial grape and wine production is mainly focused on international cultivars, and the 2024 register's named leaders include Chardonnay, Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon; however, the sources use 'international', not the narrower 'Western European', and cultivar counts must not be substituted for planted-area shares.
category: структура коммерческих посадок по происхождению сортов

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / хронология формирования сортимента
book_quote: Так сложилось в 1970-е
statement: The 1970s were the peak of Yugoslav mass wine production, but a specialist historical review dates Serbia's intensive vineyard-planting phase and associated introduction of new cultivars to 1959-1970, while several Western European cultivars had entered after phylloxera and before the Second World War; the book's single-decade causal date is therefore too narrow and somewhat late.

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / роль крупных комбинатов и масштаб посадок
book_quote: крупные винодельческие комбинаты закладывали огромные площади
statement: Large Serbian state wineries and intensive vineyards planted with numerous international cultivars are documented, but around 1970 about 106,000 hectares were in the individual sector and 10,500 hectares in the state sector; the combines were influential, yet the wording implies a scale and ownership share not established by the evidence.

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / влияние комбинатов на поставщиков
book_quote: и заодно определяли сортимент тех, у кого скупали виноград
statement: Government and historical sources document that large wineries bought grapes from small and individual producers and that the socialist wine system was centralized and quota-oriented, but the selected corpus does not demonstrate that Serbian combines prescribed the specific cultivars planted by those suppliers.

location: Международные сорта / вводная статистика / редакционный приоритет автохтонов
book_quote: Автохтоны интереснее и объясняют характер регионов
statement: The comparative claim that autochthonous cultivars are more interesting is an editorial value judgment, and 'explain the character of regions' is a broad interpretive thesis rather than a measurable finding; sources can support their importance for regional identity and genetic resources, not an objective superiority over international cultivars.

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / идентичность и отличие от рейнского рислинга
book_quote: Грашац · итальянский рислинг вельшрислинг ... Родства с рейнским рислингом нет
statement: Grašac/Grašac Beli, Italian Riesling/Riesling Italico, Graševina and Welschriesling are established names for the same white cultivar, VIVC 13217, which current genetic and reference sources distinguish from Rhine Riesling.
category: идентичность, синонимия и генетическое отличие сорта

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / международный и домашний статус
book_quote: Формально международный, фактически домашний: «он у нас дома», говорят энологи
statement: Welschriesling is distributed internationally across Central and Southeastern Europe and is not a uniquely Serbian genotype, while two centuries of documented Serbian cultivation and a strong modern Fruška Gora identity support calling Grašac culturally and agriculturally at home in Serbia; the exact quotation and its collective attribution to unnamed oenologists remain untraceable.

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / доля посадок двух регионов
book_quote: Больше половины посадок Фрушки горы и Вршца
statement: A 2017 paper repeats an older estimate that Italian Riesling occupied more than half of Fruška Gora vineyards, while the more-than-50-percent figure found for Vršac concerns the assortment of the large Vršački vinogradi enterprise rather than all vineyards of the Vršac wine district; no current register supports the combined present-tense claim for both regions.

book_quote: переживает возрождение
statement: Serbian and regional producers have deliberately restored the Grašac name, expanded site-specific, lees-aged, barrel, sparkling, skin-contact and sweet styles, and gained new international recognition, supporting a modern reputational and stylistic revival rather than a revival of cultivation from disappearance.

book_quote: Соломенно-жёлтый
statement: Young dry Welschriesling/Grašac is commonly pale green-yellow or light yellow, while riper, older and more concentrated examples move through straw and golden tones; straw-yellow is a plausible appearance within the range but not a universal cultivar colour.

book_quote: сухой
statement: Dry still wine is a common and important Grašac style, but the cultivar also produces off-dry and sweet wines, sparkling wines, botrytised and ice wines, and skin-contact versions; the unqualified adjective describes a style, not the cultivar as a whole.
category: стиль по остаточному сахару и винификации

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / интенсивность сортового аромата
book_quote: с выраженным сортовым ароматом
statement: Grašac has a repeatable fruit, floral, herbal and sometimes mineral aromatic range, but authoritative profiles often describe young dry Welschriesling as delicate or formerly neutral and current Serbian guidance stresses versatility rather than one dramatic aroma; pronounced varietal intensity depends on site, ripeness, yield and winemaking.

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / цитрус и зелёное яблоко
book_quote: цитрус, зелёное яблоко
statement: Citrus, especially lemon, lime or grapefruit, and green or yellow apple are repeatedly documented in international cultivar references, current Serbian guidance, scientific aroma work and named Serbian Grašac wines.

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / горьковатая финишная нота
book_quote: приятная горчинка в послевкусии
statement: A slight, gently bitter or almond-bitter finish is a recurrent Grašac/Welschriesling descriptor, although its intensity and exact flavour association vary among wines and it is not mandatory in every example.

location: Международные сорта / Грашац / утверждение об отсутствии миндального дескриптора
book_quote: «миндальной» её называют по привычке, источники говорят просто о приятной горечи
statement: The selected source corpus does not merely report generic pleasant bitterness: a current specialist synthesis explicitly describes slight almond bitterness, and independent tastings of Serbian Grašac also record almond or marzipan notes, especially with bottle age; almond should remain an optional descriptor rather than be dismissed as unsupported habit.

book_quote: Алкоголь невысокий, 11–13% объёмных
statement: Many fresh dry Serbian Grašac wines fall around 12–13% alcohol and generic profiles describe modest alcohol, but current examples reach 13.5% and a documented barrel-aged version reaches 14.5%; 11–13% is a useful range for lighter styles, not a cultivar-wide limit or complete current range.

book_quote: общая кислотность 5–7 г/л в пересчёте на винную кислоту
statement: Current Serbian dry-still examples commonly sit near 5.4–6.5 g/L total acidity and therefore fit the stated range, but documented Grašac wines also reach 7.2–7.5 g/L and other styles can differ; Serbian and OIV analytical convention permits total acidity to be expressed as tartaric-acid equivalents, so the unit is sound but the numerical range needs a style and vintage scope.

location: Международные сорта / Шардоне / распространение и роль
book_quote: Шардоне повсюду Одна из опор современной сцены
statement: At end-2025 Chardonnay was Serbia's leading white cultivar and third cultivar overall, representing 9% of registered commercial vineyard area; current national and specialist inventories document still and sparkling examples across northern Vojvodina and several central Serbian regions, so it is demonstrably a major pillar while «повсюду» remains rhetorical rather than a literal claim about every district.

book_quote: Три из семи золотых медалей Decanter 2026 у Сербии — за шардоне
statement: Three of Serbia's seven Gold-winning wines at DWWA 2026 were Chardonnay wines: Tarpoš Chardonnay Extra Brut 2021, Zvonko Bogdan Chardonnay 2022 and Zvonko Bogdan Éclater Blanc de Blancs Brut Nature 2018; the producer identifies Éclater 2018 as Chardonnay, so the arithmetic is correct even though the third label does not put the cultivar in its short name.

book_quote: и отдельной строкой платина Deurić
statement: Deurić La Rem Chardonnay 2023 from Fruška Gora, Srem received a Platinum medal at DWWA 2026; the official Platinum list identifies the producer, wine, region and vintage, while competition and specialist reporting give 97 points.

book_quote: Север даёт сдержанные и прохладные версии
statement: Northern Serbia does produce fresh, precise or restrained Chardonnay examples, including Deurić La Rem 2023 and a bright-acid Južni Banat wine, but the same current tasting corpus also records full, generous, ripe 14.5% and broad creamy northern examples; restraint is one northern style, not a defensible region-wide rule.

book_quote: Шумадия — плотнее и спелее
statement: Several documented Šumadija Chardonnays are dense or ripe, including Aleksandrović Aberdar and Savić Chardonnay 2022, but the same regional corpus includes a bright 12% sparkling Chardonnay and the precise, acidity-driven Camille 2024; without a controlled regional sample, Šumadija cannot be ranked categorically as denser and riper than northern Serbia.

book_quote: Шумадия, Фрушка гора
statement: Sauvignon Blanc is well documented in both Šumadija and Fruška Gora and represented 5% of Serbia's registered commercial vineyard area at end-2024, but current directories and tastings also place it in other central, northern and southern districts; the two named regions are important examples rather than a complete Serbian distribution.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / зелёные ароматы
book_quote: В Сербии даёт крыжовник, бузину и свежескошенную траву
statement: Gooseberry, elder or elderflower, and freshly cut grass are all documented in Serbian Sauvignon Blanc, but not necessarily together or in every bottle: named northern, central and southern examples combine them in different proportions with citrus, stone fruit and tropical fruit.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / южный стиль
book_quote: а на юге — ноты жёлтых фруктов вместо зелёных
statement: The available Serbian corpus does not support a categorical south-versus-green substitution: wines from Šumadija and farther south often combine peach, apricot or pineapple with grass, nettle, gooseberry, apple, lime or herbs, while northern wines likewise mix green and ripe stone-fruit notes; «south» is also undefined and Šumadija is conventionally central Serbia.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / производитель SoviNoa Fumé Blanc
book_quote: SoviNoa Fumé Blanc от Matijašević
statement: SoviNoa Fumé Blanc is a barrel-aged Sauvignon Blanc made by Matijašević Vinogradi in Orašac, Šumadija.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / оценка лучшей версии
book_quote: Лучшая здешняя версия — SoviNoa Fumé Blanc
statement: SoviNoa Fumé Blanc 2023 has a strong attributable basis for being highlighted: Beth Willard scored it 96, selected it as Top White Wine and made it the highest-scoring Sauvignon Blanc in her 268-wine Serbia 2026 guide; that result supports «a leading example in this guide», not an unqualified, permanent title as Serbia's objectively best Sauvignon Blanc.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / источник 96 баллов
book_quote: с 96 баллами Decanter
statement: The 96-point score for SoviNoa Fumé Blanc 2023 came from Beth Willard's independent New Europe Wine Guide – Serbia 2026, not from Decanter or DWWA; Decanter's official record instead gives the 2021 vintage a DWWA 2023 Gold medal with 95 points.

location: Международные сорта / Совиньон блан / категория победителя
book_quote: где он стал лучшим совиньоном конкурса
statement: The New Europe Wine Guide was a multi-day guide tasting, not a competition, and designated SoviNoa Fumé Blanc 2023 Top White Wine rather than «best Sauvignon Blanc»; it was the highest-scoring Sauvignon Blanc in that guide, but the printed category covered all white wines.

book_quote: Княжевац, Неготин, Фрушка гора
statement: Rhine Riesling is currently documented in Knjaževac, the Negotin wine region and Fruška Gora: Džervin declares a varietal Knjaževac Riesling, regional and regulatory sources record it around Negotin, and active Fruška Gora producers list Rhine Riesling in their vineyards or portfolios.

location: Международные сорта / Рейнский рислинг / отличие от грашца
book_quote: Настоящий рислинг, в отличие от грашца
statement: Rhine Riesling and Grašac are distinct cultivars: Grašac is Serbia's local name for Welschriesling/Italian Riesling and is unrelated to Rhine Riesling. Calling the latter «true Riesling» is understandable as a naming disambiguation, but should not imply that Grašac is counterfeit or qualitatively illegitimate.

location: Международные сорта / Рейнский рислинг / превосходство в Неготине
book_quote: В Неготине показал себя лучше прочих белых
statement: Rhine Riesling is demonstrably grown and vinified in the Negotin region, but the selected corpus contains no defined comparative tasting, award series or production metric establishing it as better than every other local white cultivar; this is an authorial preference unless an assessor and comparison set are named.

location: Международные сорта / Рейнский рислинг / Dubravka Gold
book_quote: в Княжевце идёт в Dubravka Gold
statement: Džervin's current Dubravka Gold 2024 contains 50% Italian Riesling and 50% Sauvignon Blanc, not Rhine Riesling. Rhine Riesling from Knjaževac instead appears in Džervin's separate varietal Riesling 2021 and at 30% in the basic Dubravka 2024, so the book has conflated three labels and two different cultivars carrying the word Riesling.

location: Международные сорта / Бургундац бели и сиви / идентичность
book_quote: Бургундац бели · сиви ... Пино блан и пино гри
statement: Burgundac beli/Beli burgundac is a Serbian synonym of Pinot Blanc, and Burgundac sivi/Sivi burgundac is a Serbian synonym of Pinot Gris; Pinot Grigio is the Italian name for the same grey-skinned cultivar.

location: Международные сорта / Бургундац бели и сиви / Воеводина
book_quote: Воеводина
statement: Both Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are currently grown and bottled in Vojvodina, with documented examples in the Subotica/Palić area and in Srem; the regional label is correct as presence evidence but does not quantify their share of Vojvodina's vineyards.

location: Международные сорта / Бургундац бели и сиви / роль современных посадок
book_quote: Основа современных посадок
statement: Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are visible components of modern Serbian portfolios and can yield high-scoring wines, but the 2024 commercial Vineyard Register's list of leading white cultivars is Grašac 11%, Chardonnay 9%, Riesling 6% and Sauvignon Blanc 5%, with neither Pinot listed; without a stated regional denominator, calling the pair «the foundation of modern plantings» overstates their measured national role.

location: Международные сорта / Бургундац бели и сиви / пески Палича
book_quote: особенно на песках Палича
statement: The Palić/Subotica area has prominent modern Pinot Blanc and Pinot Grigio examples, including a declared four-hectare Palić Pinot Blanc block and Petra Pinot Grigio by Lake Palić; however, the wider sandland contains arenosol, clay, chernozem-with-sand and other soils, and Petra's site is described as clay- and loam-rich, so «on Palić's sands» requires a named vineyard rather than a blanket soil attribution.
category: связь сорта с местом и почвой

book_quote: Жупа, Неготин
statement: Current records document Sémillon in both Župa and Negotinska Krajina: Vino Župa's regional inventory includes it, while Vinarija Raj bottles the varietal Zenit at Rajac and Frunza Aglaja grows Sémillon at Smedovac and uses it with Sauvignon Blanc.

location: Международные сорта / Семильон / редкость и историческая непрерывность
book_quote: Редкий гость, но держится с югославских времён
statement: Sémillon is rare in present-day Serbia and has documented Serbian history reaching at least the royal Oplenac plantings of the late 1920s, with current examples in several regions. The evidence does not establish that today's Župa or Negotin parcels descend continuously from a specific Yugoslav-era planting, so «has persisted since Yugoslav times» is a broad historical summary, not a vineyard-lineage fact.

book_quote: Даёт плотное белое с восковой текстурой и невысокой кислотностью
statement: Full body and moderate-to-low acidity are established potential characteristics of dry Sémillon, and oily or waxy texture is a conventional descriptor. They are not compulsory Serbian outcomes: current Serbian examples include a citrus-fresh Sauvignon blend, a dry varietal Zenit and a concentrated naturally sweet varietal Eden wine, so style, harvest point and vinification must be named.

location: Международные сорта / Семильон / купажи и сортовые вина
book_quote: в Сербии чаще идёт в купажи, чем в сортовые вина
statement: The public corpus shows both uses—Frunza Aglaja's Sauvignon–Sémillon blend and at least two varietal bottlings, Raj Zenit and Eden Sémillon 2018—but provides no dated national production or label census. It therefore cannot establish that blends are more frequent than varietal wines in Serbia.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне совиньон / географический приоритет
book_quote: Неготин прежде всего
statement: Negotinska Krajina is a prominent Serbian Cabernet Sauvignon terroir with recognised wines, but it is not the cultivar's principal region by current commercial planted area: Serbia's Centre for Viticulture and Winemaking identifies Tri Morave, Srem and Šumadija as the three regions with the largest Cabernet areas and states that the cultivar is grown throughout Serbia.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне совиньон / сенсорный профиль
book_quote: Чёрная смородина, кедр, табак, плотный танин
statement: Blackcurrant and a firm tannic structure are classic Cabernet Sauvignon traits, while cedar and tobacco commonly arise or intensify with oak ageing and bottle development. Named Kremen vintages reproduce much of this profile, but the four descriptors are potential, vintage-dependent associations rather than a compulsory signature of every Serbian Cabernet.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне совиньон / зрелость сербского стиля
book_quote: в Сербии сорт даёт спелые, но не перезрелые версии, особенно на востоке
statement: Balanced ripe Cabernet is documented in Serbia and the eastern Kremen wines provide strong examples, but «ripe, not overripe» is not a national rule: a current 268-wine guide also records Serbian Cabernets described as jammy, very ripe, overtly sweet-fruited or high-alcohol. Ripeness must therefore be attached to a producer, vintage and tasting, not to Serbia or the east as a whole.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне совиньон / мнение профессора Петровича
book_quote: Профессор Петрович называет Неготинскую Крайину идеальной для него
statement: In an April 2025 interview, University of Belgrade associate professor Aleksandar Petrović explicitly called Negotinska Krajina ideal for Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Gamay; a later interview described its Cabernet as good, full and rounded. This is accurately attributed expert judgment, not a controlled comparison proving universal ideality.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне совиньон / Kremen и Decanter 2026
book_quote: подтверждение тому линия Kremen от Matalj: платина Decanter 2026
statement: Matalj's Kremen Kamen 2021 from Negotinska Krajina received 97 points and Platinum at DWWA 2026. The result strongly supports the quality potential of one Cabernet wine and site, but a competition medal does not by itself prove that an entire multi-subregion area is objectively ideal for the cultivar.
category: награда вина и предел доказательного вывода

book_quote: повсюду Самый распространённый международный красный страны
statement: By current commercial planted area, Merlot is Serbia's leading red cultivar and therefore its most widespread international red: CEVVIN ranks it second among all cultivars, behind the white Grašac, while Cabernet Sauvignon is third; the 2024 Serbian vineyard register gives Merlot 11% and Cabernet Sauvignon 9%. Its largest areas are Tri Morave, Srem and Leskovac, so «everywhere» is a colloquial statement of broad national presence, not even distribution.

book_quote: Сербские версии обычно мягкие и сливово-вишнёвые, с умеренным танином
statement: Plum and red-cherry or red-berry fruit recur in current Serbian Merlot tastings, and supple tannins are an established varietal potential. The same Serbian corpus also contains firm-tannined, structured, jammy, opulent and 15–15.5% alcohol examples, so softness and moderate tannin are useful tendencies rather than a verified description of the usual national wine.

book_quote: на севере получаются свежее, на юге плотнее
statement: No controlled or population-level Serbian comparison establishes a north-fresher/south-denser Merlot gradient. A current multi-region guide records fresh, elegant wines in the far north but also 15% alcohol, jammy and warm Merlots in northern Srem, while central and eastern examples range from fresh and balanced to dense and port-like; producer, site, vintage, harvest and élevage override the proposed binary.

location: Международные сорта / Мерло / Zvonko Bogdan и Decanter
book_quote: У Zvonko Bogdan мерло 2023 взяло 95 баллов Decanter
statement: Vinarija Zvonko Bogdan Merlot 2023 from Palić in the Subotica region received 95 points and Gold at the 2025 Decanter World Wine Awards. The competition and year should be named; a separate 2026 specialist guide scored the same wine 94, which is a distinct critic's assessment rather than a contradiction of the DWWA result.
category: награда и точная атрибуция оценки вина

location: Международные сорта / Пино нуар / Опленац и Княжевац
book_quote: Пино нуар Опленац, Княжевац
statement: Current producer records document Pinot Noir in both named places: Aleksandrović bottles a varietal still red from Bokanja on Oplenac in Šumadija, while Džervin in Knjaževac currently bottles a varietal Pinot Noir rosé and a Pinot-based rosé blend. These examples establish presence, not equal scale, importance or a shared red-wine style.

location: Международные сорта / Пино нуар / оценка качества в Шумадии
book_quote: В Шумадии удаётся неожиданно хорошо
statement: Named Šumadija Pinot Noirs demonstrate commercially viable and independently reviewed wines, but the comparative phrase 'unexpectedly well' has no defined benchmark, representative sample or blind regional comparison. Current tasting evidence can support named successful examples, not a general surprise or superiority claim for Šumadija.

location: Международные сорта / Пино нуар / климат Княжевца
book_quote: В прохладном Княжевце
statement: Official Serbian zoning material describes Knjaževac as a mountain-framed vineyard area with varied elevations and conditions cooler than Serbia's hottest lowland sites, while technical cultivar references place Pinot Noir primarily in cool to moderate climates. 'Cool Knjaževac' is defensible only as a relative shorthand, not as a complete climate classification without a period, station and temperature indices.

location: Международные сорта / Пино нуар / гастрономическая пара
book_quote: просится к птице и грибам
statement: Poultry and mushroom pairings are directly recommended for Aleksandrović's Oplenac Pinot Noir, so the pairing is plausible for a named Serbian wine. Current Knjaževac Pinot-based rosés carry different producer recommendations—fish and grilled dishes for the varietal rosé, and chicken salads or roasts for the blend—so the poultry-and-mushroom pairing cannot be presented as evidence of a specifically Knjaževac style.

location: Международные сорта / Франковка / Фрушка гора и Суботица
book_quote: Фрушка гора, Суботица
statement: Frankovka/Blaufränkisch is documented in both named northern Serbian zones. Current records place Verkat's Frankovka-led blend and Maurer's varietal Kékfrankos on Fruška Gora, while Maurer's Subotica holdings include Kékfrankos and use it in local wines. Presence is established, but the heading does not quantify vineyard area or regional importance.

book_quote: Блауфранкиш
statement: Frankovka, Blaufränkisch, Kékfrankos and Limberger are regional names or accepted synonyms of the same Vitis vinifera cultivar, VIVC 1459. The book's cross-reference is correct, although diacritics and the local name should be normalised consistently.

book_quote: Средней плотности, с живой кислотой
statement: High or lively acidity is a recurrent Blaufränkisch trait and appears in current Serbian examples. 'Medium density' is less stable: references and wines span light, refreshing versions through structured, tannic and oak-aged styles, and density itself is undefined. The sentence is usable only as a broad tendency rather than a fixed Serbian profile.

book_quote: франковка от Verkat взяла Best buy 2025 среди красных
statement: Vino.rs placed FRANKOVKA 2023 VERKAT in its 2025 Best Buy category for red wines from international cultivars. The award is an editorial selection by vino.rs, not a general competition title, and the wine is FranFrankovka, a blend documented as 85% Frankovka and 15% Cabernet Franc rather than a varietal Frankovka.

book_quote: Гаме Неготин
statement: Gamay is currently grown and bottled in Negotinska Krajina. Serbia's specialist viticulture centre identifies the region among the cultivar's three largest Serbian commercial zones, current regional reporting lists Gamay among its most represented international cultivars, and multiple Negotin-area wineries offer varietal or blended Gamay wines.

book_quote: Сажают с 1960-х
statement: The reviewed official, regional, producer and six-language Wikipedia corpus does not date the first, renewed or continuous planting of Gamay in Negotinska Krajina to the 1960s. A current producer documents a 2017 wine from vines described as over forty years old, but that imprecise age statement cannot establish the claimed decade or uninterrupted regional continuity.

location: Международные сорта / Гаме / сенсорный и структурный профиль
book_quote: Лёгкое и ягодное
statement: Light body and berry-led fruit are common international Gamay profiles, especially for young wines and carbonic or whole-bunch styles. They are not a secure local norm: current Negotinska Krajina sources explicitly describe Gamay there as fuller, more intense and ageworthy, and one regional expert calls the wines full and rounded.

location: Международные сорта / Гаме / укоренённость в регионе
book_quote: здесь давно не экзотика
statement: Although «not exotic» is informal and supplies no measurable threshold, Gamay is demonstrably established in Negotinska Krajina: it occupies significant regional commercial area, appears in current monastery and private-winery plantings, is sold in varietal and blended forms by several local producers, and one bottling is sourced from vines described as over forty years old.

book_quote: Северноитальянский сорт из Трентино
statement: Teroldego is a black wine-grape cultivar of Italian origin, VIVC 12371, historically and commercially centred on Trentino and especially the Piana or Campo Rotaliana. Calling it a northern Italian cultivar from Trentino is accurate regional shorthand, although VIVC identifies the country rather than proving one exact birthplace.

location: Международные сорта / Терольдего / редкость вне родины
book_quote: за пределами родины редкий
statement: Teroldego remains strongly concentrated in Italy and particularly Trentino, while documented plantings outside that core occur in smaller pockets in countries including the United States, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand and Serbia. «Rare outside its homeland» is defensible as a relative distribution claim, not as exclusivity or absence elsewhere.

location: Международные сорта / Терольдего / Šapat и Нови-Сланкамен
book_quote: В Сербии его сажает Šapat
statement: Atelje vina Šapat grows Teroldego in its own vineyard estate and currently bottles the 100% Teroldego Terol 2022. The winery and visitor complex use a Novi Slankamen address, while the producer locates the vineyards more precisely in Slankamenački Vinogradi; the book's place label is serviceable but geographically compressed.

location: Международные сорта / Терольдего / соседние сорта и участок
book_quote: рядом с франковкой и мерло на лёссовом склоне над Дунаем
statement: Šapat lists Teroldego, Blaufränkisch and Merlot within the same estate's more than twelve hectares of vineyards. The vineyards lie mainly on a southern hill slope at 210–235 metres, with a thin chernozem topsoil over deep lime-bearing loess and views toward the Danube. The evidence establishes one estate and setting, but not that the three cultivars occupy immediately adjacent rows or identical parcels.
category: сортовой состав хозяйства, рельеф и почва

location: Международные сорта / Каберне фран, марселан и сира / география
book_quote: Топлица, Шумадия, Неготин
statement: The three place names are defensible only as a collective list for the three-cultivar group, not as a claim that every cultivar is documented in every place. The reviewed official and current evidence supports Cabernet Franc and Marselan in Toplica, all three cultivars in Šumadija, and Cabernet Franc plus Marselan in Negotinska Krajina; the corpus does not establish a current Syrah planting in either Toplica or Negotinska Krajina.
category: география посадок и логика группового заголовка

location: Международные сорта / Каберне фран, марселан и сира / хронология
book_quote: Молодая волна посадок
statement: The phrase «young wave of plantings» has no date range, baseline, hectares or planting years. The corpus shows current wines and a small 2019 Marselan footprint, but it does not establish one shared Serbian planting wave for Cabernet Franc, Marselan and Syrah or distinguish new vineyards from newly marketed labels.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне фран / сравнительная структура
book_quote: Каберне фран в Сербии обычно легче каберне совиньона … танин мягче
statement: Cabernet Franc is generally described internationally as lighter and less tannic or less powerful than Cabernet Sauvignon. Current Serbian tastings include elegant, lightly grippy and genuinely light examples, but also a 16% alcohol, rich and opulent varietal wine; no representative national comparison establishes «usually» for Serbia.

location: Международные сорта / Каберне фран / ароматический профиль
book_quote: малина, зелёный перец, графит
statement: Raspberry and bell- or green-pepper characters recur in the international Cabernet Franc corpus, while graphite is documented in a current Serbian varietal example. These are plausible style-dependent descriptors rather than a mandatory national fingerprint; pepper expression is especially sensitive to ripeness and viticulture.

book_quote: французское скрещивание 1961 года, каберне совиньон с гренашем
statement: Marselan was obtained by INRA in France in 1961 by crossing Cabernet Sauvignon with Grenache. The date and parentage agree across the French technical catalogue and the multilingual encyclopedic corpus.

location: Международные сорта / Марселан / цель селекции и признаки ягоды
book_quote: выведенное ради устойчивости к болезням и мелкой ягоды с плотной кожицей
statement: Disease tolerance, very small berries and thick skins are documented Marselan traits, but they were not the stated original breeding goal. The historical account says the programme sought productive large-berried material and initially shelved Marselan because its berries were too small; later disease tolerance renewed interest. Its resistance is also selective rather than universal.

book_quote: даёт густой цвет, чёрные ягоды и шелковистый танин
statement: Authoritative cultivar sources consistently describe Marselan wines as intensely coloured, aromatic and structured with supple, harmonious, non-bitter tannins and ripe red- and black-fruit notes. «Black berries» is ambiguous in Russian because it may mean either fruit aroma or the grapes themselves; the evidence supports both dark-skinned berries and black-fruit descriptors, but they should be written separately.

book_quote: 20,21 га на 40 участках по инвентарю 2019 года
statement: The CEVVIN inventory published in 2019 records Marselan at 20.21 hectares on 24 vineyard parcels, not 40. The number 40 belongs to the immediately following Župski Bojadiser row, so the book has shifted one table value upward; the figure must also remain explicitly dated rather than presented as current.
category: площадь, число участков и ошибка чтения таблицы

book_quote: Сира здесь чаще идёт в старосветском ключе — перец, фиалка, дым, а не джемовая спелость
statement: Pepper, violet and smoky notes are established Syrah descriptors, while warmer or riper styles may become fuller and jammier. Current Serbian examples span lean peppery, smoky and fresh wines as well as juicy modern, very ripe, powerful and high-alcohol styles; the reviewed non-random corpus cannot support the national-frequency word «чаще» or a simple old-world-versus-jam binary.
category: сенсорный стиль, климат и национальная частотность

location: Международные сорта / Ркацители / Жупа и Княжевац
book_quote: старые участки Жупы и Княжевца
statement: Rkatsiteli is currently documented in both Župa and Knjaževac. A Župa winery places it on small historical mixed-variety parcels, while a Knjaževac regional source calls it an old cultivar and a current 2025 varietal wine specifies 0.9 hectares of local high-altitude plots. Only the Župa source explicitly establishes historical parcels; national data identify Tri Morave, South Banat and Negotinska Krajina as the largest current zones.

location: Международные сорта / Ркацители / происхождение и тип
book_quote: Грузинский белый сорт
statement: Rkatsiteli is a Georgian Vitis vinifera cultivar with blanc berry skin, VIVC 10116, used chiefly for white wine and also documented for table-grape use in its area of origin.

book_quote: один из старейших в мире
statement: Rkatsiteli is widely characterised as an ancient Georgian cultivar and is often called one of the world's oldest. The exact superlative and a specific multi-millennial cultivar age are not securely established by the reviewed primary catalogue: sources range from a first-century emergence tradition to claims based on ancient grape seeds that do not present a modern genetic identification in the cited text.

location: Международные сорта / Ркацители / причина интродукции в Сербию
book_quote: попавший в Сербию не из-за вкуса, а по разнарядке
statement: The Serbian technical corpus dates the start of Rkatsiteli cultivation to the 1970s but does not document a government quota, compulsory allocation or a rejection of wine quality as the reason for introduction. The contrast between «taste» and «directive» is therefore an unsupported causal narrative.

book_quote: в шестидесятые и семидесятые его массово сажали по всему соцлагерю
statement: Rkatsiteli became exceptionally widespread in the Soviet Union and by 1978 accounted for a reported 18% of Soviet wine production; it also had important plantings in several Eastern European and Black Sea countries. Serbia's specialist centre dates local cultivation only from the 1970s. The evidence does not support «throughout the socialist bloc» or a common 1960s–1970s planting window for every country.

book_quote: за урожайность и морозостойкость
statement: Winter-frost tolerance is consistently documented. Productivity is less uniform: Plantgrape calls Rkatsiteli relatively productive, whereas Serbia's CEVVIN reports moderate yields, low shoot fruitfulness and a need for long pruning. These traits may explain agronomic appeal, but the reviewed sources do not establish that yield and frost tolerance were the actual policy motives for Serbian or bloc-wide planting.

book_quote: Новых посадок почти нет
statement: No cultivar-specific Serbian age structure, annual planting series or old-versus-new hectare split was found. A 2019 inventory records substantial commercial area, while Serbian nurseries currently offer Rkatsiteli planting material, but neither fact measures how many new hectares have actually been planted.
category: динамика новых посадок и отсутствие возрастного ряда

location: Международные сорта / Ркацители / сохранность старых участков
book_quote: на старых участках он держится до сих пор
statement: Current evidence directly documents Rkatsiteli on small historical mixed parcels in Župa and continued regional cultivation and wine production in Knjaževac. It supports survival in at least some legacy settings, but does not provide planting years, vine ages or a national estimate of old-vine area.
category: современная сохранность и доказанность возраста лоз

book_quote: Высокая кислотность
statement: High retained acidity is a well-supported Rkatsiteli trait in Serbian, French, English, Russian and Georgian sources, although measured acidity varies with ripeness, site and vinification and not every commercial style will taste equally sharp.

book_quote: нейтральный вкус
statement: Rkatsiteli is better described as relatively quiet, restrained or simple in primary aroma than as neutral in taste. Russian material calls standard wines neutral in aroma and Plantgrape calls the berries simple-flavoured, but authoritative Georgian and French profiles still describe fruity wines; skin-contact qvevri versions can be markedly complex.

book_quote: яблоко, айва, иногда лёгкая пряность
statement: Green apple and quince are directly documented for restrained European-style Rkatsiteli, while spicy notes recur in general and qvevri descriptions. The descriptor set is credible with a style qualifier: skin contact can shift the wine toward dried fruit, honey, orange peel, nuts, tannin and stronger spice.
category: фруктовые и пряные дескрипторы по стилю

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / источник и страницы
book_quote: официальный отчёт за 2025 год, «Зелёная книга 2025», книга II, с. 37–40 источник S2
statement: The cited PDF is the Serbian Ministry of Agriculture's official Report on the State of Agriculture in the Republic of Serbia in 2025, Book II. Its printed pages 37–40 contain the viticulture and wine section and all four cited indicators; the PDF itself was created and posted in June 2026, so «за 2025 год» identifies the reference year, not the publication year.

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / плодоносящие виноградники
book_quote: Плодоносящих виноградников 17,4 тыс. га
statement: The ministry report gives 17.4 thousand hectares as Serbia's 2025 area under bearing vineyards, based on Statistical Office data, down from 17.7 thousand hectares in 2024. This is a statistical estimate of bearing vineyard area, not total planted vineyard land of every age and not the Vineyard Register area; the underlying Serbian statistics omit unavailable data for Kosovo and Metohija.
category: площадь плодоносящих виноградников и статистический охват

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / Виноградарский реестр
book_quote: товарных участков в виноградарском реестре около 6,9 тыс. га
statement: At the end of 2025 the Vineyard Register recorded about 6.9 thousand hectares of vineyard parcels, which the report describes as predominantly commercial vineyards. Calling every registered parcel «commercial» is too categorical: the legal registration obligation covers every grape producer with at least 0.1 hectare and also smaller producers who market grapes.
category: административная площадь, коммерческий охват и порог регистрации

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / объяснение разницы площадей
book_quote: Это не «остальное в тени»: реестр ведёт счёт прежде всего товарным посадкам, а общая площадь включает и домашние виноградники, которых в Сербии много
statement: The 17.4-thousand-hectare statistical series and the 6.9-thousand-hectare administrative register are different measurement systems, and small family vineyards are materially important: the 2023 agricultural census counted 18,201 hectares on 52,557 holdings, including 6,845 hectares on holdings below 0.5 hectare. Yet the legal register scope is not simply «commercial only», and holdings of 0.1 hectare or more are generally required to register. The entire gap therefore cannot be explained as household vineyards versus commercial vineyards without data on register completeness and methodological reconciliation.
category: сопоставимость охватов, семейные хозяйства и полнота реестра

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / выпуск вина
book_quote: Заявленный выпуск вина — 27,2 млн литров
statement: The Winery Register reports that active registered producers declared 27.2 million litres of wine production in 2025, 18% above the 2024/2025 production year. The number is correctly called declared production, but it is production intended for market within the register and should not be conflated with the Statistical Office's separate 18.5-million-litre industrial-production measure or with unregistered household wine.
category: заявленное производство, Винарский реестр и область показателя

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / число производителей
book_quote: число производителей — 521
statement: The 2025 report records 521 registered wine producers that operated, meaning they had wine production intended for market during the year. The bare phrase «number of producers» needs this qualifier: it is not a count of every entity ever entered in the register and does not include household winemakers outside registered market production.

location: Международные сорта / Цифры отрасли / сопоставимость рядов
book_quote: цифры из других лет и других сводок считаются иначе и с этими несопоставимы
statement: Keeping the four headline figures within one official report is methodologically prudent, but the blanket incomparability claim is false. The report itself compares the same RZS vineyard-area series from 2016–2025 and the same Winery Register producer series from 2021–2025. What must not be interchanged are differently defined measures, such as 18.5 million litres of statistically registered industrial production versus 27.2 million litres declared to the Winery Register, or bearing-vineyard estimates versus registered parcels.

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / географическая привязка
book_quote: Бермет стиль · Сремски Карловци
statement: Serbian Bermet is strongly associated with Sremski Karlovci and the wider Fruška Gora/Srem wine area; Sremski Karlovci remains its best-known production centre. It is not exclusive to the town: research sampled producers in Sremska Kamenica, Novi Sad and Irig as well, and a separate Croatian Bermet tradition survives around Samobor.
category: географический центр, региональный охват и неэксклюзивность

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / тип и ароматизация
book_quote: Ароматизированное десертное вино на травах, специях и сухофруктах
statement: Bermet is a sweet aromatized wine made from a red or white wine base with macerated or extracted herbs, fruits and spices, commonly including dried plant parts. «Dessert wine» accurately describes a common use and market category, although Bermet can also be served as an aperitif or digestif.
category: тип напитка, сладость и ароматические компоненты

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / вариативность рецептуры
book_quote: Единого рецепта нет: у каждого хозяйства свой, и держат его в секрете
statement: Bermet recipes and extraction procedures are not standardised and differ among producers; family and monastery traditions commonly treat exact proportions and methods as secrets. The absolute «every winery» wording is not directly audited producer by producer, and several current producers publicly disclose grape bases, ingredient counts and prominent aromatic components while withholding the full formula.
category: стандартизация, семейные рецепты и степень секретности

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / полынь
book_quote: Полынь есть почти во всех
statement: Wormwood (Artemisia absinthium, Serbian pelin) is repeatedly named as a characteristic Bermet bittering herb and appears in a published experimental formulation; Serbian and German descriptions also list it among common ingredients. No representative survey of commercial recipes establishes the quantitative phrase «almost all», because the formulas are generally undisclosed.

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / Vinum
book_quote: у Vinum двадцать два ингредиента — сушёная слива, инжир, апельсиновая корка, изюм, корица, гвоздика
statement: Vinum's official current red Bermet page describes a combination of 22 kinds of fruit and spices and names dried plum, fig, orange peel and dried grape aromas plus cinnamon and clove on the nose. The source does not present a complete ingredient declaration or clearly state that each named sensory note is a literal ingredient, so the book should attribute these as the producer's disclosed flavour description rather than an open recipe.
category: производительская карточка, число компонентов и статус дескрипторов

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / Veritas Ćuković
book_quote: у Veritas Ćuković двадцать трав, растений и фруктов на основе мерло
statement: Veritas Ćuković's official current page calls its red Bermet a sweet aromatized wine enriched with more than 20 medicinal herbs and spices and describes dried fruit, cinnamon, clove, anise, vanilla and dark chocolate. Current retail and wine-media records identify the red version as Merlot-based, but the official page does not say exactly 20 or classify the set as «herbs, plants and fruits»; it says more than 20 herbs and spices.
category: основа Veritas, число и тип ароматических компонентов

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / алкоголь
book_quote: Крепость обычно 16–18%
statement: A usual Bermet alcohol range of 16–18% by volume is consistently reported in the scientific literature and the English, German and Serbian encyclopedic corpus, while current examples include Vinum at 16%, Veritas white at about 16.5–17% and Veritas red retail listings at 18%.
category: алкогольная крепость и диапазон текущих образцов

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / сахар
book_quote: сахара — несколько десятков граммов на литр
statement: A peer-reviewed technical description gives 50–150 g/L sugar for Bermet and used 70 g/L in its experimental wines. «Several tens» captures only part of that range and may understate sweeter examples; current producer pages generally label the wines sweet without publishing analytical residual sugar.
category: содержание сахара, технический диапазон и отсутствие текущих анализов

location: Стили, а не сорта / Бермет / подача
book_quote: Подают охлаждённым, к десерту
statement: Serving Bermet with desserts is well supported, including Vinum's pairing with Karlovci kuglof, but it is also widely served as an aperitif or digestif. Temperature guidance varies: current official Vinum and Veritas pages recommend 16–18°C, some retailers 10–12°C, English Wikipedia 18–20°C and German Wikipedia unchilled. «Slightly cooled, often with dessert» is defensible; a single cold-service rule is not.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Фрушка гора / почва
book_quote: лёсс, мергель
statement: Loess is a defining and widespread surface material across Fruška Gora, and historical viticultural descriptions also identify vineyard soils formed over loess and marl. The two-word cell is a useful shorthand, not a complete soil inventory: chernozem, pararendzina and other local soils also occur, while marl is not demonstrated as a universal vineyard substrate.
category: региональная геология, почвы и пределы табличного сокращения

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Фрушка гора / фактор
book_quote: южная экспозиция склонов
statement: Southern slope exposure is an important mesoclimatic and viticultural factor on Fruška Gora, and vineyards are repeatedly described on its gentler southern slopes. Available evidence supports prominence and practical importance, but not the stronger claim that every site—or a measured majority of all vineyards—has southern exposure.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Фрушка гора / флагманы
book_quote: грашац, траминац
statement: Grašac is strongly supported as a flagship of Fruška Gora by long regional tradition, identity work and an older estimate placing it above half of vineyard area. Traminac is a prominent and diverse regional speciality with multiple recognised wines, but the corpus does not establish an objective two-grape ranking; «flagships» is therefore an editorial selection rather than an exhaustive acreage table.
category: региональные флагманские сорта и редакционный критерий

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Фрушка гора / одна фраза
book_quote: Свежее, но спелое
statement: The phrase «fresh yet ripe» is a defensible editorial synthesis for many Fruška Gora wines: prior regional evidence and tasting material repeatedly combine ripe fruit with lively acidity, freshness and cleanliness. It is not a measurable regional rule and should not be read as describing every variety, site, vintage or winemaking style.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Суботица / почва
book_quote: песок
statement: Sand is the defining substrate of the Subotica–Horgoš sands and a legitimate one-word orientation for the region. It is not a complete soil description: pure sands alternate with sandy chernozem, loess transitions and more fertile patches, while groundwater, irrigation, organic matter and subsoil materially change vineyard behaviour.
category: региональные песчаные почвы и пределы табличного сокращения

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Суботица / фактор
book_quote: крайняя континентальность
statement: Subotica has a temperate climate with a pronounced continental character, warm summers and cold winters. The stronger label «extreme continentality» is not established by the selected climatic corpus, and the chapter's associated claims of uniformly dry summers and exceptional diurnal range also require quantitative comparison rather than a superlative.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Суботица / флагман
book_quote: кадарка
statement: Kadarka is a strongly documented emblematic red grape of the Subotica–Palić area: dedicated local estates, old-vine material and current award-winning wines make it a defensible editorial flagship. The available register evidence shows that national acreage is small and does not establish Kadarka as the region's largest planting, so «flagship» denotes identity rather than dominance.
category: региональный флагманский сорт и критерий идентичности

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Суботица / одна фраза
book_quote: Прозрачное и пряное
statement: «Transparent and spicy» works as an editorial shorthand for the area's characteristic Kadarka: the grape is repeatedly described as pale or light ruby yet flavourful and spicy. «Transparent» is a visual metaphor, not an analytical category, and the phrase cannot represent all Subotica wines, which also include Chardonnay, sparkling wine and concentrated Bordeaux-style blends.
category: редакционный сенсорный образ и его сортовые границы

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Вршац / почва
book_quote: смоница
statement: Smonica—broadly a Vertisol-type, shrink–swell heavy clay—is documented in the South Banat/Vršac vineyard context and is a defensible soil orientation. It is not the area's only important soil: chernozem («crnica») and local sandy materials are also reported, so the one-word cell is deliberately non-exhaustive.
category: региональная почва, терминология Vertisol и неполнота перечня

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Вршац / фактор
book_quote: холодная глина, поздний сбор
statement: A wet, heavy Vertisol profile can warm slowly and may delay vine development where drainage is weak, but «cold clay, late harvest» is a conditional mechanism rather than a measured regional rule. Vršac ripening cannot be inferred from the soil name alone, and even Kreaca's late-ripening classification conflicts across secondary ampelographic descriptions.
category: тепловой режим тяжёлой глины и условность позднего созревания

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Вршац / флагман
book_quote: креаца
statement: Kreaca is an old Pannonian cultivar especially associated with Vršac and Banat, and the 2019 Serbian commercial-vineyard inventory placed roughly two thirds of its 31.69 ha in South Banat. This makes it a defensible identity flagship, although it is not the area's dominant planting and its synonyms should not be expanded to Temišvarka without precise ampelographic authority.
category: локальный флагманский сорт, распределение и синонимия

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Вршац / одна фраза
book_quote: Кислотное и строгое
statement: An acid-led, restrained profile is defensible as an editorial shorthand centred on Kreaca and some traditional Vršac white blends: prior sources support comparatively modest sugar accumulation and acidity prominent on the palate. «Strict» remains a subjective descriptor, and neither high acidity nor austerity is established for every local grape, blend, vintage or cellar style.
category: редакционный сенсорный профиль белых вин и его пределы

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Шумадия / почва
book_quote: гайняча + камень
statement: Gajnjača, commonly correlated with eutric Cambisol in Serbian regional usage, is an important Šumadija vineyard soil, and coarse stone or gravel occurs in some profiles. The formula is incomplete: Vertisol/smonica is also widespread, while «stone» is a profile property rather than a soil class and its drainage or thermal effects depend on depth, texture, connectivity, colour and moisture.
category: региональные почвы, грубые фрагменты и терминологические границы

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Шумадия / фактор
book_quote: микроклимат склона
statement: Slope position, elevation and exposure are well-supported sources of mesoclimatic variation in Šumadija: the formal regional description places vineyards across 80–400 m, commonly 150–350 m, on several warm-facing slopes and plateau tops. «Slope microclimate» is therefore a sound driver, but it is a bundle of variables rather than a single measured cause of quality.
category: мезоклимат участка, высота и экспозиция склонов

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Шумадия / флагманы
book_quote: прокупац, пино нуар
statement: Prokupac is a defensible local flagship of Šumadija through regional tradition and multiple important contemporary wines. Pinot Noir has a documented historical and current presence, especially at Oplenac, including notable still and sparkling examples; however, the corpus does not establish an objective two-grape ranking or equal regional importance.
category: региональные флагманские сорта и неравный критерий выбора

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Шумадия / одна фраза
book_quote: Элегантное, надёжное
statement: «Elegant, reliable» is an editorial value judgement, not a falsifiable regional profile. Named Šumadija Prokupac and Pinot Noir wines can support examples of polished texture, balance or repeat recognition, but the terms have no defined metric, and the diverse region also contains ripe, powerful, barrel-aged and sparkling styles.
category: субъективная оценка стиля и отсутствие критерия надёжности

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Жупа / почва
book_quote: скелетный гравий
statement: Župa includes slope soils with a high share of coarse fragments such as gravel and stones, often described locally as skeletal and valued for permeability where the subsoil remains porous. The phrase does not name a single formal soil class and is not demonstrated as the only or dominant soil across the entire Župa vineyard area.
category: каменисто-гравийные почвы, крупная фракция и пределы распространения

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Жупа / фактор
book_quote: замкнутая котловина
statement: Župa is a basin framed by the Kopaonik, Željin, Goč and Jastrebac mountain systems, so topographic enclosure is a defensible regional driver. «Closed» should remain descriptive rather than absolute: the basin belongs to the West Morava drainage system and no evidence establishes hermetic climatic isolation or a single quantified mountain-protection effect.
category: котловинная топография, горное обрамление и климатические пределы

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Жупа / флагманы
book_quote: прокупац, тамьяника
statement: Prokupac and white Tamjanika are strongly supported as Župa's identity flagships through long regional cultivation, current specialist producers and repeated industry presentation. The pairing is editorial rather than exhaustive, and «flagship» does not mean that a current register proves equal or first-ranked acreage for both grapes.
category: региональные флагманские сорта и критерий идентичности

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Жупа / одна фраза
book_quote: Пряное и ароматное
statement: «Spicy and aromatic» is a coherent editorial synthesis through Župa's two selected flagships: Tamjanika is explicitly an aromatic Muscat, while Prokupac can show pepper, herbs and other spice notes. The descriptors are non-exclusive and cannot define every Župa wine, variety, vintage or vinification.
category: редакционный сенсорный профиль через два флагманских сорта

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Неготин / почва
book_quote: смоница, гайняча, песок
statement: The official Negotinska Krajina description supports Vertisol and eutric Cambisol—approximately corresponding in local usage to smonica and gajnjača—along with sandy areas. The row correctly signals diversity but remains incomplete: alluvial deposits, gravelly clay, thin soils over sandstone, schist and gneiss, and strong variation among the five vineyard subareas are also documented.
category: региональная почвенная мозаика и местные соответствия терминов

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Неготин / фактор
book_quote: солнце + жара
statement: Sun and summer heat are well-supported climatic drivers in Negotinska Krajina: the 1981–2010 regional material reports 2,109 sunshine hours, summers are hot and prolonged, and extreme days can approach 40°C. These conditions can raise grape sugar and potential alcohol, but site, soil, yield, water status and harvest date prevent a deterministic one-line rule.
category: солнечность, летняя жара и потенциальный алкоголь

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Неготин / флагманы
book_quote: багрина, зачинак
statement: Bagrina and Začinak are rare traditional cultivars strongly associated with Negotinska Krajina: Bagrina is a local white identity marker, while Začinak is a teinturier historically used to deepen colour in regional blends. They are defensible heritage flagships, not demonstrated acreage leaders or an exhaustive pair; Crna Tamjanika is another major regional calling card.
category: редкие региональные сорта, наследие и пределы флагманского выбора

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Неготин / одна фраза
book_quote: Мощное и алкогольное
statement: Powerful, high-alcohol reds are a recognisable part of Negotin's current repertoire, consistent with warm-site sugar potential and named Cabernet, Vranac and blend examples around 14–15% ABV. The phrase is not a universal regional profile: Bagrina, Gamay, rosé and sparkling wines can be lighter or fresher, and alcohol depends on grape, harvest and fermentation decisions.
category: редакционный профиль мощных красных и границы обобщения

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Топлица / почва
book_quote: смоница, гайняча
statement: Smonica/Vertisol and gajnjača/eutric Cambisol are well-supported principal soil orientations for Toplica. The pair is not exhaustive: the official regional material also identifies alluvial soils in places, local profiles are intermingled, and everyday Serbian names should not be treated as exact one-to-one international classifications.
category: основные региональные почвы и границы местной терминологии

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Топлица / фактор
book_quote: двойная горная защита
statement: The Toplica basin is framed by mountain systems to the north and south, including Jastrebac, Vidojevica and Pasjača, so two-sided mountain enclosure is a defensible topographic shorthand. «Protection» is not quantitatively established: the mountains shape circulation and local mesoclimates, but the corpus does not show a single measured shielding effect or prove that it uniformly moderates extremes.
category: горное обрамление котловины и недоказанный защитный эффект

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Топлица / флагман
book_quote: прокупац
statement: Prokupac is exceptionally well-supported as Toplica's identity flagship: it is widely grown there, the cultivar's modern name is linked to Prokuplje, and regional producers sustain both traditional and premium versions. The name connection does not by itself prove that the grape biologically originated in Toplica, and «flagship» is a cultural and commercial role rather than a current acreage superlative unless a dated register is cited.
category: региональный флагман, связь имени и пределы вывода о происхождении

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Топлица / одна фраза
book_quote: Классическое, недорогое
statement: Toplica still offers a recognisable traditional, unpretentious Prokupac pole, which can justify «classic» if the term is defined through cherry, herbs, spice and earthy notes rather than a value hierarchy. «Inexpensive» is dynamic and unverified as a region-wide quality-to-price claim: a dated, representative price comparison is absent, and current producers also make premium wines.
category: традиционный стиль, динамическая цена и оценочное соотношение качества

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Юго-восток / почва
book_quote: смешанные
statement: «Mixed» is accurate but minimally informative for the editorial Southeast grouping: it combines five official regions—Knjaževac, Niš, Nišava, Leskovac and Vranje—with different basins, elevations and soil mosaics. Official descriptions include Vertisol/smonica, Cambisol/gajnjača, rocky slope profiles and other local soils, so no single soil can responsibly represent the whole grouping.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Юго-восток / фактор
book_quote: долинные коридоры
statement: Valley corridors are a sound geographic organising factor, but there are at least two distinct systems: Knjaževac belongs to the Timok basin, while Niš, Leskovac and Vranje align more closely with the Južna Morava corridor. The valleys may channel air movement, transport and settlement, yet the selected corpus does not quantify one uniform warm-air or wine-style effect across all five regions.
category: долинная география, разные бассейны и недоказанный единый климатический эффект

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Юго-восток / флагманы
book_quote: вранац, пино нуар
statement: Vranac and Pinot Noir are both documented in the Southeast grouping, but asymmetrically: Vranac is permitted and currently bottled in several southern regions, whereas Pinot Noir is especially visible around Knjaževac and in specific cool or elevated sites. The pair is an editorial contrast, not a two-grape ranking or a shared flagship set for all five official regions.

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Юго-восток / одна фраза
book_quote: Территория находок
statement: «Territory of discoveries» is a recommendation and value judgement rather than a verifiable regional sensory profile. The grouping does contain diverse lesser-known producers, grapes and price points, but the corpus supplies no defined measure of discovery, under-recognition or value and cannot compare the Southeast objectively with every other Serbian region.
category: редакционная рекомендация и отсутствие сравнительного критерия

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Смедерево / почва
book_quote: аллювий, террасы
statement: Alluvial soils and Danube terraces occur around Smederevo, but «alluvium, terraces» is not an adequate soil summary for the formal Beogradski region or even all Smederevo vineyards. The official and agricultural corpus gives important roles to gajnjača/eutric Cambisol and smonica/Vertisol, while terraces are a landform and alluvial sites vary in texture, depth and groundwater.
category: почва и рельеф, ошибочность доминирующей пары

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Смедерево / фактор
book_quote: ровные условия
statement: «Even conditions» is not supported as a regional driver. The formal Beogradski region spans five vineyard subareas from the Kolubara side to the Morava mouth, with different elevations, soils, exposures and proximity to the Danube; Smederevo also experiences continental seasonality and Košava episodes, and no metric of «evenness» is defined.
category: неоднородность условий и отсутствие измеримого критерия ровности

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Смедерево / флагман
book_quote: смедеревка
statement: Smederevka is a highly defensible identity flagship for Smederevo by name, historical association and current local production. This does not establish it as the largest present planting in the broad Beogradski region, and the cultivar is also grown and made elsewhere in Serbia and neighbouring countries.
category: региональный сортовый флагман и пределы географической исключительности

location: Приложение В / Все регионы разом / Смедерево / одна фраза
book_quote: Простое и освежающее
statement: Freshness and noticeable acidity are well-supported for many young Smederevka wines, and simple, clean everyday bottlings form an important traditional style. «Simple» is not a universal quality ceiling: sparkling, skin-contact, late-picked and oak-aged premium interpretations exist, including examples made outside Smederevo.
category: базовый освежающий стиль и существование сложных интерпретаций

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / медали DWWA 2026 / Сербия
book_quote: Сербия взяла 3 платины, 7 золотых, 58 серебряных и 78 бронзовых — 146 медалей ... сербские пресс-релизы называли 149
statement: Снимок официального API DWWA 2026 с фильтром Serbia, зафиксированный в книге 9 августа 2026 года, даёт 146 записей: 3 Platinum, 7 Gold, 58 Silver и 78 Bronze. Сообщение PKS даёт 149: 3 Platinum, 7 Gold, 60 Silver и 79 Bronze; расхождение в три медали публично не объяснено.
category: датированные итоги конкурса и конфликт источников

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / масштаб DWWA 2026
book_quote: На 23-м Decanter из почти 17 000 образцов ... вина приехали из 58
statement: DWWA 2026 был 23-м конкурсом; организатор сообщает о почти 17 000 оценённых винах из 58 стран.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / судейская коллегия DWWA 2026
book_quote: Судили 245 экспертов из 35 стран ... 63 Master of Wine и 24 Master Sommelier
statement: Официальные итоги DWWA 2026 указывают 245 судей из 35 стран, включая 63 Masters of Wine и 24 Master Sommeliers.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / ограничения медального корпуса
book_quote: участвуют только поданные образцы, а подача стоит денег — значит, результаты описывают выборку приславших
statement: DWWA оценивает только зарегистрированные и доставленные образцы, а базовая плата за заявку 2026 года составляла £172 без логистики. Поэтому результаты описывают самоотобранный корпус участников, а не статистически репрезентативную перепись всего сербского виноделия.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / мнение белградского сомелье
book_quote: часть вин, способных взять платину, туда просто не поехала ... результаты значат сегодня меньше, чем пять-шесть лет назад
statement: Неназванный в тексте белградский сомелье считает, что некоторые потенциально платиновые сербские вина не были поданы, а индикативная ценность конкурсных результатов снизилась по сравнению с периодом пяти-шести лет назад.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / соседи на DWWA 2026
book_quote: Хорватия — 1 Best in Show, 5 платин, 34 золота ... Албания — только бронза
statement: Датированный срез официальных результатов DWWA 2026 даёт для Хорватии 1 Best in Show, 5 Platinum и 34 Gold; для Словении 2 Platinum и 12 Gold; для Боснии и Герцеговины 5 Gold; для Северной Македонии 3 Gold; для Черногории 2 Gold; у Албании наивысшей медальной категорией была Bronze.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / Erdevik Platinum 2020
book_quote: шардоне Omnibus Lector винодельни Erdevik в 2020 году
statement: Erdevik Omnibus Lector Chardonnay 2015 был единственным сербским Platinum-медалистом DWWA 2020 и получил 97 баллов.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / историческое первенство Platinum
book_quote: Первую взяло ... в 2020 году, и более ранних сербских платин в результатах конкурса нет
statement: Награда Erdevik 2020 была первой сербской Platinum в истории DWWA, а до неё у Сербии не было эквивалентной высшей награды конкурса.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / Vinčić Best in Show 2023
book_quote: грашац винодельни Vinčić получил ... Best in Show — вошёл в число пятидесяти лучших вин мира
statement: Vinarija Vinčić Grašac 2020 получил 97 баллов и Best in Show DWWA 2023, то есть вошёл в официальный Top 50 конкурса из 18 250 оценённых образцов.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / девять сухих белых
book_quote: в девяти лучших сухих белых
statement: Vinčić Grašac 2020 был одним из девяти сухих белых вин среди 50 Best in Show DWWA 2023.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / иерархия DWWA
book_quote: Best in Show стоит выше платины: это высшая награда, какую сербское вино получало на Decanter
statement: В процедуре DWWA Gold-медалисты проходят отбор на Platinum, после чего все Platinum повторно дегустируются для выбора Best in Show; Vinčić 2023 остаётся первым и высшим сербским результатом DWWA этого уровня.

location: Приложение Г / Кто на вершине / Драгойлович и два хозяйства
book_quote: Обе винодельни — Matalj и Matijašević — называют его своим энологом ... его рукой сделан Kremen Kamen
