statement: The checked corpus supports the existence of prominent white wines from Fruška Gora and red wines from Šumadija, but it does not establish that these two region-and-colour groups have Serbia's smallest buyer-relevant dispersion. No matched blind dataset compares Serbian regions by variance in quality score, sensory style, defects, value or consumer satisfaction, while peer-reviewed work documents meaningful site, mesoclimate and wine-style variation within Fruška Gora itself.
category: неизмеренная межрегиональная репутация предсказуемости и наименьшего разброса

location: Семь привычек / шесть виноделен, которые почти не подводят
book_quote: Имена, которые почти не подводят: Deurić, Kovačević и Erdevik на севере, Aleksandrović, Radovanović и Matijašević в Шумадии
statement: Deurić, Kovačević, Erdevik, Aleksandrović, Radovanović and Matijašević all have public indicators of prominence, scale, repeat recognition or award-winning individual wines. Those examples do not establish the portfolio-wide frequency assertion that the six wineries almost never disappoint: the checked corpus contains no exhaustive multi-vintage sample, common tasting protocol, failure threshold or denominator covering their releases, prices and retail condition.
category: репутационный список производителей и неподтверждённая частота удачных покупок

location: Семь привычек / Неготин и Жупа как выбор за характер
book_quote: Нужен характер — Неготин и Жупа
statement: Negotinska Krajina and Župa have well-documented distinctive grapes, wine histories and contrasting current wine examples, so they are defensible destinations for an author seeking wines with a pronounced regional or producer identity. The imperative to choose them when one needs 'character' remains a preference-dependent purchasing heuristic because the corpus supplies no common definition or national comparison of wine character.
category: авторская рекомендация регионов по неопределённому понятию характера

location: Семь привычек / более широкий разброс качества в Неготине и Жупе
book_quote: Разброс качества там шире
statement: The checked material documents substantial stylistic and producer variation in Župa and heterogeneous sites and wine styles in Negotinska Krajina, but it does not establish that the dispersion of wine quality in both regions is wider than elsewhere in Serbia. Style diversity, site diversity and a history of uneven mass-market versus premium examples are not a measured distribution of quality under a shared tasting scale.
category: неизмеренное сравнительное утверждение о региональном разбросе качества

location: Семь привычек / лучшие вина ярче всех в стране
book_quote: лучшие вина ярче, чем где-либо в стране
statement: Highly rated and award-winning wines provide evidence that Negotinska Krajina and Župa can produce strong individual examples. They do not establish that the best wines from those regions are more vivid, expressive or distinctive than the best wines anywhere else in Serbia: 'brightest' has no defined sensory metric, the set of best wines is unspecified, and no cross-region blind comparison was found.
category: неопределённый национальный суперлатив лучших вин двух регионов

location: Семь привычек / четыре стартовых хозяйства Неготина и Жупы
book_quote: Чтобы не тратить попытки впустую, начните с Matalj и Francuska vinarija в Крайине, Ivanović и Temet в Жупе
statement: Matalj, Francuska Vinarija, Ivanović and Temet are all documented active reference points with distinctive products, practices, recognition or regional standing, which makes them a defensible authorial starter list. The stronger implication that choosing them minimizes wasted attempts is not measured: the corpus contains no common multi-vintage sample, failure rate, price-adjusted comparison or coverage of each complete portfolio and retail condition.
category: авторский шорт-лист хозяйств и неподтверждённое снижение риска неудачной покупки

location: Семь привычек / роль склона для Prokupac
book_quote: У прокупца многое решает склон
statement: Prokupac is vigorous and productive, and site conditions commonly associated with slope—exposure, drainage, soil depth, water status and fertility—can materially affect vine balance and grape ripening. The checked corpus does not quantify how much slope itself determines finished-wine outcome relative to cultivar management, rootstock, season and winemaking, so the phrase is defensible only as a site-selection heuristic rather than a measured dominant cause.
category: значение участка и неопределённая доля причинного влияния склона

location: Семь привычек / равнина, жирование лозы и пустое вино
book_quote: на равнине сорт жирует и даёт пустое вино
statement: Prokupac can develop excessive vegetative growth under favourable water and nutrient conditions, but flat terrain is not equivalent to fertile or wet soil and the checked corpus contains no paired flat-versus-slope Prokupac trial showing that plains inherently produce an 'empty' wine. The sensory term is undefined and outcome also depends on load, canopy, season, harvest and vinification.
category: недоказанная цепочка равнина — избыточный рост — пустое вино

location: Семь привычек / бедная каменистая земля и плотное вино
book_quote: на бедной каменистой земле — плотное
statement: Serbian cultivar references favour loose, permeable, gravelly and moderately fertile warm soils for Prokupac, and a current low-humus Oplenac site with sand and stone supplies a concrete structured-wine example. This supports the plausibility of the advice but not a universal causal rule: stone content, soil depth, subsoil, water and yield interact, 'poor' is not the same as moderately fertile, and no paired experiment proves that such ground necessarily produces dense wine.
category: предпочтение проницаемых гравийных почв и недоказанная гарантия плотности

location: Семь привычек / отсутствие рельефа среди обязательных данных этикетки
book_quote: На бутылке рельеф не написан
statement: Serbian wine labelling rules do not require a standardized statement of slope, inclination or relief among the mandatory particulars, so a bottle normally cannot be expected to disclose topography directly. A producer may voluntarily mention a vineyard, hill or site in lawful text, but the absence of relief data is not evidence that the vineyard is flat and any optional wording still requires interpretation.
category: необязательность рельефа на этикетке и предел вывода из его отсутствия

location: Семь привычек / Župa, Aleksandrovac, Oplenac и Topola как подсказки участка
book_quote: зато написаны имена, за которыми он стоит: Александровац и Жупа, Опленац и Топола
statement: Župa and Oplenac are official vinogorje names under Tri Morave and Šumadija respectively. Aleksandrovac and Topola are useful locality clues within those geographies, but a city name may occur as a producer address, brand or narrative and does not by itself prove grape origin, an official geographical indication or a sloped vineyard. Even an official vinogorje narrows declared origin rather than encoding a particular relief.
category: официальные виногорья, городские подсказки и отсутствие гарантии склона

location: Семь привычек / четыре хозяйства как ориентиры Prokupac
book_quote: Из хозяйств — Ivanović, Veličković, Aleksandrović, Kostić в Топлице
statement: Ivanović, Veličković, Aleksandrović and Kostić are defensible Prokupac reference producers, but they illustrate different places and styles rather than a single slope rule. Ivanović is associated with Aleksandrovac/Župa, Veličković's current Marbel card places the producer in Banja near Aranđelovac in Šumadija rather than Župa, Aleksandrović supplies an Oplenac example, and Kostić is based in Prokuplje/Toplica.
category: география и стилевое разнообразие четырёх ориентиров Prokupac

location: Семь привычек / пустое горлышко не определяет статус вина
book_quote: Пустое горлышко при этом не признак
statement: The absence of a Serbian evidenciona markica specifically on the bottle neck does not determine geographical-origin status. The mark for domestic GI wine must be conspicuous and legible on each original package but the neck is not mandatory; an imported GI wine keeps its original designation, and a completely absent domestic mark may indicate lawful non-GI wine or non-compliant labelling of claimed GI wine. The whole package and country of origin must be checked.
category: недостаточность пустого горлышка для определения GI-статуса

location: Семь привычек / большинство сербского вина вне GI по объёму
book_quote: большинство сербских вин просто вне системы географического происхождения
statement: The 2025 Winery Register report shows that wine without geographical origin represented 91% of declared Serbian production volume, versus 9% combined for G.I., K.P.K. and K.G.P.K. This confirms a large majority by reported volume, not necessarily by number of wines, bottles, retail SKUs, shelf space or sales, and it does not imply that non-GI wine escaped the ordinary legal quality-control requirements for commercial wine.
category: большинство не-GI по объёму производства и пределы статистического вывода
